text:
Sam: Quick pulse from the all-hands  can folks drop 1-2 bullets on recent wins/losses and one ask for leadership? Well triage tomorrow. Keep it tight.

Priya: Win: caching + batching demo knocked ~28% off token spend in two POCs. Customers quoted cost math as the reason to move forward. Ask: produce a one-paragraph benchmark blurb + copy-paste code.

Diego: Loss: a payments prospect asked for an opinionated signal router plugin we don't ship. Ask: a short decision doc (tradeoffs + estimate) so sales can answer RFPs.

Omar: Loss: mid-market infra team bailed on Private because installer felt fragile. Ask: create a supported one-click install script or containerized quickstart.

Kira: Win: Console traces + per-request latency breakdown were repeatedly called out in demos. Ask: highlight this feature more prominently in the sales deck (one slide).

Jordan: Re: model choices  SEs still get the "which model for X" question. Ask: 3-line cheat sheet (latency / cost / quality) we can paste into trial emails.

Sam: Leaving these as the main asks: benchmark blurb, signal decision doc, installer quickstart, Console slide, model cheat sheet. Reply +1 to confirm or add a short customer quote we can use.

Priya: +1. Quote: "Your cache cut our projected infra spend in half for the POC."

Diego: +1. Ill draft the signal doc template with product by Thu.

ops-bot: Heads up: follow-up survey live now.

Sam: Thanks all 44D Ill make a triage board and ping owners tomorrow.
